# October on the plots

The first frosts are close. This month we look at garlic, leaf mould and the seed swap on the 31st.

## Plant your garlic

Split the bulbs into cloves and set them 15 cm apart, pointed end up. A sunny bed with good drainage is best.

[Read the garlic guide](https://allotment-letter.example.com/garlic?utm_source=letter&utm_medium=email)

## Make leaf mould

Fill a wire cage or a bin bag with wet leaves, punch a few holes and leave it for a year.

[How we do it](https://allotment-letter.example.com/leaf-mould?utm_source=letter&utm_medium=email)

## Seed swap

- Saturday 31 October, 10:00 to 13:00
- The hut by the north gate
- Bring seeds in labelled envelopes

Tea and cake from the committee, 50p a slice.
